name: Sacred Lineage
original_name: 幻聖神姫LINEAGE －セイクリッドリネージュ－
source:
Note: the title was changed from "Sacred Lineage" to "Sacred Virth" in 2016.

There existed a sword of light that possesses unlimited magical power, Arv. Arv belonged to Arkthrone Kingdom, but due to the king's sudden collapse, the kingdom started to lose its power. Seeing the opportunity, a sorcery organization by the name of Gatea attacked Arkthrone for the possession of Arv. However, Gatea and Arkthrone's battle became a stalemate. During that time, Forneus, a sorcerer from Gatea, learned the existence of Princess Tierna who had fled to human world for refuge. Forneus attempted to abduct her and use her against Arkthrone, but when he arrived at the human world what he found was a mysterious transformed heroine that stood against him.

「I am the Silver Guardian, Sacred Claire! 」The warrior declared her name, and despite the amount of plans that Forneus had prepared, he suffered a great defeat.

So, Forneus transferred to the school to learn about the princess's whereabouts while formulated his plan to fight. He found the weakness of Sacred Lineage using "humiliation guerilla". But right before Claire was defeated, another transformed heroine appeared.

However, Forneus also planned to conquer her later on as well. The holy warriors experienced repeated humiliated defeat. In the end, will the young girls bound by chains of pleasure be able to prevail and bring the hope back?

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=847728]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
注：标题在2016年从“Sacred Lineage”改为“Sacred Virth”。

世上曾存在一把拥有无限魔力的光之剑阿尔夫。阿尔夫属于阿克斯隆王国，但由于国王突然倒下，王国开始衰落。魔法组织盖特亚抓住机会，袭击阿克斯隆，企图夺取阿尔夫。然而，盖特亚与阿克斯隆的战斗陷入僵局。期间，盖特亚的魔法师福尔纽斯得知，为避难而逃往人界的蒂尔娜公主的存在。他试图绑架公主，将她作为对付阿克斯隆的武器；但抵达人界后，等待他的却是一名神秘的变身女英雄。

“我是银之守护者，圣洁克莱尔！”战士宣告了自己的名字。尽管福尔纽斯准备了大量计划，仍遭遇惨败。

于是，福尔纽斯转入学校，试图查明公主的下落，同时制定战斗计划。他利用“羞耻游击”找到了圣洁血统的弱点。然而，就在克莱尔即将败北时，另一名变身女英雄出现了。

但福尔纽斯也计划日后征服她。圣战士们不断遭受羞辱性的失败。最后，被快乐锁链束缚的少女们能否取得胜利，将希望带回来？

[译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=847728]Getchu[/url]]
